name: Home page - seções e navegação
description: Visitante acessa a página inicial e verifica todas as seções visíveis

planSteps.description: Verify the hero section displays 'Black Diamond' branding and an 'Agendar' call-to-action button
Click on the Agendar button in the hero section
Verify the browser navigates to the booking/agendar page
Verify the services section with at least 3 service cards showing names and prices is visible below the hero
Verify the About/Sobre section with barber photo and bio is visible
Verify the location/map section with address or embedded map is visible
Verify the footer with opening hours, Instagram link, and WhatsApp contact is visible
